name: Young Mazino
bio:
Christopher Young Kim (born August 27, 1991), known professionally as Young Mazino, is an American actor. He had his breakout role in the Netflix series Beef (2023), for which he was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award. As of 2025, he stars in the HBO drama series The Last of Us as Jesse.
